# SimJury

> SimJury is one account-free fictional courtroom experience. Eleven Minutes unfolds over five weekday court sessions and a weekend jury deliberation, about twenty minutes per session. The player listens to both sides, tests admitted evidence with eleven authored jurors, and may return Murder, manslaughter, Not Guilty, or remain unable to agree.

SimJury is served entirely as static assets. Progress, private notes and ballots
stay in the browser; an explicit local export/import file provides device
transfer. Reviewed media comes from one pinned GitHub Release. There is no runtime AI,
analytics, account, multiplayer room, waitlist or gameplay API.

## Canonical public pages

- [Home](https://simjury.com/): Product introduction, adult fiction notice and entry to Court Week.
- [Court Week](https://simjury.com/jury/): The seven-session audio-first courtroom and deliberation experience.
- [Privacy](https://simjury.com/privacy/): Local state, explicit device transfer, static delivery and media-request boundaries.

## Site access

- [Complete machine-readable site guide](https://simjury.com/llms-full.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://simjury.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots policy](https://simjury.com/robots.txt)

## Boundaries

These guides do not reproduce or link case facts, testimony, exhibits, juror
rules, ballots, outcomes or analysis. `/today/`, `/play/` and `/install/` are
compatibility redirects to `/jury/`.
